/**
 * ====================================================================
 * MEMORIES PHOTO COLLECTION (15 Photos)
 * ====================================================================
 * Add or replace your photos inside the public/images/ directory:
 *   public/images/photo1.jpg
 *   public/images/photo2.jpg
 *   ...
 *   public/images/photo15.jpg
 *
 * If any image file is missing, the application gracefully renders
 * an elegant cinematic artistic placeholder card without breaking!
 */

export const memories = [
  {
    id: 1,
    image: "/images/photo1.jpg",
    caption: "That golden afternoon where we couldn't stop laughing.",
    tag: "Golden Hours",
    date: "A quiet moment",
    rotation: -2.5,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    image: "/images/photo2.jpg",
    caption: "A memory worth keeping forever in a little pocket of time.",
    tag: "Unforgettable",
    date: "Late evening",
    rotation: 1.8,
    yOffset: 12,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "270px",
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    image: "/images/photo3.jpg",
    caption: "The coffee was cold, but the conversation was electric.",
    tag: "Warmth",
    date: "Sunday morning",
    rotation: -1.2,
    yOffset: -14,
    scale: 1.04,
    aspect: "1/1",
    width: "290px",
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    image: "/images/photo4.jpg",
    caption: "Underneath city lights, feeling like time stood still.",
    tag: "Starlight",
    date: "Midnight walk",
    rotation: 3.1,
    yOffset: 8,
    scale: 0.96,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    image: "/images/photo5.jpg",
    caption: "Your genuine smile when you didn't even notice the camera.",
    tag: "Pure Joy",
    date: "Candid smiles",
    rotation: -2.0,
    yOffset: -6,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "275px",
  },
  {
    id: 6,
    image: "/images/photo6.jpg",
    caption: "A spontaneous road trip that became an instant favorite memory.",
    tag: "Wanderlust",
    date: "Open roads",
    rotation: 1.5,
    yOffset: 14,
    scale: 0.99,
    aspect: "16/11",
    width: "310px",
  },
  {
    id: 7,
    image: "/images/photo7.jpg",
    caption: "Quiet sunset skies painted in pink, gold, and lavender.",
    tag: "Serenity",
    date: "Dusk reflections",
    rotation: -3.0,
    yOffset: -10,
    scale: 1.03,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "285px",
  },
  {
    id: 8,
    image: "/images/photo8.jpg",
    caption: "Celebrating a milestone, proud of everything you do.",
    tag: "Proud of You",
    date: "Celebrations",
    rotation: 2.2,
    yOffset: 6,
    scale: 0.97,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "270px",
  },
  {
    id: 9,
    image: "/images/photo9.jpg",
    caption: "Cozy rainy afternoon with acoustic music playing on repeat.",
    tag: "Cozy Days",
    date: "Rainy bliss",
    rotation: -1.8,
    yOffset: -12,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "1/1",
    width: "290px",
  },
  {
    id: 10,
    image: "/images/photo10.jpg",
    caption: "The look on your face right before another burst of laughter.",
    tag: "Laughter",
    date: "Silly moments",
    rotation: 2.7,
    yOffset: 10,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
  },
  {
    id: 11,
    image: "/images/photo11.jpg",
    caption: "Seaside breeze and thoughts drifting over gentle tides.",
    tag: "Ocean Whispers",
    date: "Coastal walk",
    rotation: -2.2,
    yOffset: -4,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "16/11",
    width: "315px",
  },
  {
    id: 12,
    image: "/images/photo12.jpg",
    caption: "Another chapter, another adventure, another memory made.",
    tag: "New Beginnings",
    date: "Fresh paths",
    rotation: 1.9,
    yOffset: 12,
    scale: 0.96,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "275px",
  },
  {
    id: 13,
    image: "/images/photo13.jpg",
    caption: "A little spark of magic hidden in the most ordinary day.",
    tag: "Everyday Magic",
    date: "Little things",
    rotation: -2.8,
    yOffset: -15,
    scale: 1.03,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
  },
  {
    id: 14,
    image: "/images/photo14.jpg",
    caption: "Candlelight conversations about our dreams and hopes.",
    tag: "Deep Talks",
    date: "Warm glow",
    rotation: 1.4,
    yOffset: 8,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "1/1",
    width: "290px",
  },
  {
    id: 15,
    image: "/images/photo15.jpg",
    caption: "Holding onto this feeling forever. Here's to making many more.",
    tag: "Forever",
    date: "Timeless",
    rotation: -1.6,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.04,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "295px",
  },
];

export default memories;
